figures.finding: Bolivia's film agency ADECINE, a decentralised public body under Law No. 1134 on Bolivian Cinema and Audiovisual Art, runs the Fondo de Fomento al Cine y Arte Audiovisual Bolivianos, which funded, among others, the feature Pianoman (selected for Mannheim-Heidelberg, November 2026).
